title: Widow and Orphan Cess on Fuel Begins in Himachal Pradesh

blocks.content: Himachal Pradesh introduced a Widow and Orphan Cess on petrol and high-speed diesel under Section 6-A of the Himachal Pradesh Value Added Tax Act, 2005. The State Taxes and Excise Department issued the notification on 11 August 2026, and the levy took effect from midnight on the same day.

items: Section 6-A of the Himachal Pradesh Value Added Tax Act, 2005 provides the legal basis for the cess.
The levy applies to both petrol and high-speed diesel in Himachal Pradesh.
The maximum cess permitted under the amendment is ₹5 per litre.
The initial notified rate is ₹0.60 per litre.
